summary: Three supported local defects: interaction-only cost presented as full complexity, incomplete WUF state recurrence, and incorrect CN ablation percentage. Core displayed rankings and fixed-width linear input scaling survive inspected checks. Practical efficiency and implementation need evidence.

problems.title: Full cost expression omits width-quadratic dense-layer costs
problems.claim: Appendix L final Big-O cost sums attention interactions as all contributions.
problems.location: PDF pp23-25 Appendix L Tables5-7; p19 Appendix F
assumptions: Conventional dense feed-forward block d to4d to d as suggested by multiplier4
Positive fixed W,Ls,N,S,M,Lm while varying latent width d
Encoder/decoder dimensions distinguished from processor width
No implementation available to exclude undocumented structured layers
problems.check: Derive processor feed-forward cost8 W Lm M d^2 versus displayed O(d) at fixed other variables. Independently substitute all Table6 parameters into Table7 proxies.
problems.result: Omitted quadratic width term; proxy ratios reproduce6.28172 at T1 and2.19860 at T20. For horizon3 asymptotic proxy ratio bounded below by2.09391.
problems.counterevidence: Attention-only expression and fixed-width linear N scaling survive; p23 acknowledges higher cost/shrinking gap; no demonstrated dependency of Figure4 error curve on cost derivation. No categorical cheaper-than-FNO crossover attributed.
problems.impact: Supported local cost-model defect; complete practical cost advantage unresolved. No established core dependency warrants upgrading to Major.
problems.correction: State interaction-only scope/regime or add dense and projection terms with separate widths; obtain measured cost data for practical comparisons.
problems.repair_verification: Analytic dense count and numerical proxy substitution only; no full implementation cost verification.

problems.title: WUF pseudocode lacks state updates and valid remainder input
problems.claim: Algorithm1 implements iterative forecasting using previous predicted state.
problems.location: PDF p15 Appendix B Algorithm1; p4 main text and p3 Figure3
assumptions: Horizon H>=0 and per-call advance at most th
Only initial observations and previously predicted states available at inference
problems.check: Read literal listing: time advances but prediction never assigned as current state; r versus tr mismatch; final F uses target-time state; exact-multiple output not assigned explicitly. Construct corrected recurrence with delta=min(th,to-t).
problems.result: Listing incomplete; corrected recurrence returns current prediction and uses ceil(H/th) calls, checked on exact toy flow for horizons0,1,3,6,7,20.
problems.counterevidence: Main text and Figure3 explicitly specify feedback of predicted horizon state. No code or empirical evidence of future-target leakage or erroneous forecasts.
problems.impact: Local reproducibility defect; no demonstrated failure of central implemented algorithm.
problems.correction: Maintain state v and time t; advance by min(th,to-t), replace v with prediction, return v.
problems.repair_verification: Call-count lower-bound proof and reviewer-authored toy cases only; no author-code patch or runtime.

problems.title: CN ablation degradation percentage inconsistent with rounded errors
assumptions: Displayed inputs rounded to three decimals
problems.check: Exact100(.364/.326-1)=1900/163%; interval rounding extrema from .3635/.3265 and .3645/.3255.
problems.counterevidence: Direction and ranking unchanged; no larger empirical consequence established.
problems.correction: Use approximately11.7% from displayed values or provide underlying values and an explicit different convention.
problems.repair_verification: Exact rational and rounding-bound arithmetic checked.

limitations: No implementation archive staged; original PDF plus official/author HTML only.
No author code executed, datasets/weights downloaded, or experiments reproduced.
Complete baseline operation counts and historical experiment bindings not verified.

unresolved_claims.reason: Interaction proxies omit contributions and are not measured runtime.

unresolved_claims.claim: Query-set consistency of full learned neural field
unresolved_claims.reason: Self-attention component diagnostic does not instantiate complete SCENT; arbitrary resolution need not imply exact invariance.
Main50k versus appendix100k for S1/S2; actual run configurations missing.
